lines.say: An adaptation is an inherited feature that helps an organism survive and reproduce.
It builds up over many generations, by natural selection.
Individuals with helpful variations survive and breed more. Those alleles become common.

draw.alt: Population over generations: green helpful variant becomes more common

lines.say: A suntan is not an adaptation. It's acclimatisation, in one lifetime, and not inherited.
Structural means a body part. Ask: is it a part, a process, or an action?
Eucalypt leaves have a thick waxy cuticle, and hang edge-on to the midday sun.
Epicormic buds hide under thick bark. After fire, they sprout.

draw.alt: Burnt eucalypt trunk sprouts green shoots from epicormic buds

lines.say: Lignotubers at the base store buds and food for resprouting.
Kangaroos have long elastic tendons. Hopping uses little energy.
Physiological means a body process, something you can't see from outside.
The spinifex hopping mouse makes very concentrated urine. It loses little water.
Female kangaroos can pause an embryo in drought. That's embryonic diapause.
Some desert plants open stomata at night to save water. Mangroves remove salt.
Behavioural means an action, something the organism does.
Kangaroos lick their forearms. Evaporating saliva cools the blood.
Bilbies are nocturnal. They shelter in cool burrows by day.
Lizards bask to warm up, then move to shade when too hot.
One kangaroo shows all three types.

draw.alt: Three boxes for kangaroo adaptations: structural, physiological, behavioural

lines.say: Extremophiles thrive where most organisms can't. Thermophiles have heat-stable enzymes.
Antarctic fish make antifreeze proteins that stop ice crystals growing.
The mountain pygmy possum hibernates under snow, lowering its metabolic rate.
Heat moves through the surface. Spread-out chips cool faster than a pile.

draw.alt: Compact body keeps heat; the same body with big ears and long limbs loses heat

lines.say: Organisms don't choose adaptations because they need them.
Kidneys are a structure, but making concentrated urine is physiological.
Always explain how the feature helps survival or reproduction.
Body part, body process, or action?
Name it, classify it, explain it.
Adaptations are inherited. Acclimatisation is not.
Unfamiliar organism? Apply the same reasoning to the data given.
